cands.note: sharp pit with a mound on a low knoll about 25 m west of an old north-south track, with a second smaller pit about 40 m south-east beside the track; the 1903 map draws a building on the west side of the road here, north of a crossroads; the 1944 map draws the road as unimproved, woods to the west and no building; brushy woods on the aerial, nothing standing

sharp pit with a rim about 20 m south of a gravel road; the 1903 map draws a building on the south side of the road here, just east of where a road from the north joins; the 1944 map draws the road and open land and no building; woods on the aerial south of the road, a field north of it, nothing standing

sharp pit with a raised rim on its south-east side where faint old tracks meet, a stream gully about 60 m to the north-east; the 1903 map draws a building about 40 m north-east, west of a north-south road; the 1944 map shows open land and no building at the spot, but draws one about 90 m south-east beyond the road bend; woods on the aerial, nothing standing

very sharp rectangular pit in two parts about 15 m east of a wide straight forest track, with low banks along the track to the north and south; the 1903 map draws a building on the east side of the road here; the 1944 map draws the road as unimproved, open land and no building; evergreen plantation on the aerial hides the ground, nothing standing shows

sharp pit with a rim about 20 m west of a gravel forest road; the 1903 map draws a building on the west side of the road here; the 1944 map draws the road and no building; open woods on the aerial, nothing standing

sharp rectangular pit inside a ring-shaped rim about 20 m north of a dirt road; the 1903 map draws a building on the north side of the road here and another about 190 m east; the 1944 map draws only the eastern one; woods on the aerial, nothing standing
pit and long irregular diggings beside the road at a cleared landing; looks like a borrow pit; the 1903 building is about 100 m north

pit with a mound on its east side about 30 m west of a straight north-south line that the 1944 map draws as a trail; the 1903 map draws a building on the west side of a road here; the 1944 map shows woods and no building; brush and young woods on the aerial, nothing standing

pit with a rim and a smaller pit beside it about 25 m north of an old east-west road, with irregular diggings south of the road; the 1903 map draws a building on the north side of the road here, west of a crossroads; the 1944 map draws the road as unimproved, open land and no building; woods on the aerial, nothing standing

pit with a mound beside a low north-south bank with a row of small pits along it, about 60 m south of a gravel road; the 1903 map draws two buildings on the south side of the road, the nearer about 40 m north; the 1944 map still draws a building at the spot; woods on the aerial, nothing standing

pit with a raised rim about 30 m east of a gravel road, a stream gully on the far side of the road; the 1903 map draws a building on the east side of the road here; the 1944 map shows woods and no building; trees on the aerial hide the ground, nothing standing shows

very sharp pit in two parts about 15 m east of the straight track, but the only 1903 building near is the one west of the road that bemsf13 answers to; 92 m from bemsf13 across the road, taken as the same farm

sharp pit with a short straight bank on its south-east side about 30 m west of a straight forest track, with a second very sharp pit in two parts about 90 m south-east across the track; the 1903 map draws a building on the west side of the road about 100 m north; the 1944 map draws one building on the west side about 200 m north and none here; brushy woods on the aerial, nothing standing

sharp pit about 25 m west of a forest road, with a smaller pit to the north-west and, across the road, a rectangular banked hollow; the 1903 map draws two buildings on the west side of the road here; the 1944 map draws the road as unimproved, open land and no building; plantation and brush on the aerial, nothing standing

a cluster of small pits about 20 m west of a forest road with a low bank along it; the 1903 map draws a building on the west side of the road about 55 m south, north of a road junction; the 1944 map still draws a building at the spot; brushy woods on the aerial, nothing standing

pit inside a curved ring bank about 30 m north-west of an old road, with more diggings south of the road; the 1903 map draws a building on the north side of the road about 60 m north-east; the 1944 map draws the road, open land and no building; brush and young woods on the aerial, nothing standing
the smaller pit beside the track 37 m from bemsf1; same site
dimple on the road edge
on the line of a road or track

small pit with a short bank on plantation furrows, about 45 m east of a paved road, no rim or wall; could be a tip-up; the 1903 map does draw a building about 30 m south; a house and lawn stand about 110 m south-west across the road
soft hollow east of the road 65 m from bemsf14, with a rectangular banked hollow 30 m north; the 1903 buildings are the two west of the road that bemsf14 answers to; same farm

sharp pit at the north-west corner of a rectangle of straight banks about 20 by 30 m; the 1903 map draws a lone building about 40 m north-west with no road to it, just east of the town line; the 1944 map shows open land and no building; woods with evergreens on the aerial, nothing standing
shallow irregular hollow on rough ground
at the road edge where a drain crosses

lone pit with a mound on a low rise about 75 m north of a gravel road, a faint track running from it south-east toward the road; the 1903 map draws a building on the north side of the road about 60 m south; the 1944 map draws the road as unimproved and no building; open woods on the aerial, nothing standing
small dimple on a bench under a curved scarp
rough ground beside a stream
in the roadside ditch
small pit 20 m south of the road and about 30 m from a pond and a stream gully
soft round hollow with no edge; both the 1903 and 1944 maps draw a building about 50 m east, where the LiDAR shows a small sharp pit that is not a candidate; that one is worth a look
rough dark ground, no edge
small shallow pit about 35 m north-west of an old road corner, no sharp edge; the 1903 map does draw a building at the corner; worth a look on the ground
soft hollow
on the edge of a road beside a stream

small round pit with a raised ring about 25 m north of an old road, with irregular channels and diggings to its east; the 1903 map draws a building on the north side of the road here; the 1944 map draws the road and no building here; small enough to be a well; brush and scattered evergreens on the aerial, nothing standing
soft hollow on a rough slope beside a winding track
